## Different worlds. One browser.

Inside the arcade

Idle Startup is an incremental company simulator built on gamekit, with a separate YouTube Playables build. War Chest is a Godot tactical story prototype with a twelve-encounter campaign, animated companions and a spatial equipment chest. War Chest saves in this browser and is best played in landscape on a larger screen. Neither game includes analytics; visits to the hub are measured separately.

# War Chest

Canonical: https://idle.aliveville.com/play/war-chest/

A tactical story game about bringing the valley’s stolen winter wages home. Command Rowan, Lysa and Fen across The Last Crossing, then prepare your company around a physical 6 × 5 equipment chest.

## Play

Press Play to load the game. Read the opening conversation, prepare your company, then choose a companion and an order. End turn when you are ready for enemies to act. The campaign contains twelve encounters and three chapters.

- Click a companion portrait or press 1–5 to select freely.
- Choose an order, then a legal target. T cycles targets; F confirms.
- Space ends the turn. Z undoes the last order in the current turn.
- In camp, pack equipment into the chest. R rotates; WASD moves the cursor; F places.
- Menu contains the manual, sound and reduced-motion settings.

Browser prototype. Best in landscape on a larger screen. Saves remain in this browser; private browsing or clearing site data may remove them. Native saves are separate. Export a backup from the browser toolbar before clearing storage. This Godot game is outside the YouTube Playables lane.

[Play War Chest](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/war-chest/) · [Game directory](https://idle.aliveville.com/)

# Idle Startup

Canonical: https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup/

Idle Startup is the retained playable result of the Web Playables research lab.

## How it works

Ship product features, hire a team, raise funding rounds, and improve a simulated startup over time. The deterministic simulation continues through offline progress and resumes from a versioned local save.

## Access and privacy

The game is publicly playable without an account or installation. Saves stay in the local gamekit persistence layer; no private player state is part of public discovery.

## Distribution proof

The same game code builds for a normal browser deployment and a submission-ready YouTube Playable package through platform adapters.

Ship features. Hire the team. Raise the round.

## New game setup

- Who's the founder?
- Pick your character. Rule #1: don't run out of money.
- Founder name
- Company name
- 🎲
- Start building 🚀
- 🎲 Show me different people
- Founder
- Company

The playable page keeps player names, company names, saves, balances, progress and generated candidates in the game. This public representation contains only the authored entry instructions.

[Play Idle Startup](https://idle.aliveville.com/play/idle-startup/) · [Game directory](https://idle.aliveville.com/)
